# ClinicalKnowledge_Embedding

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The method of encoding structured and unstructured medical knowledge (e.g., EHRs, literature) into vector representations for LLM inference. Informs how TCC/iNEST architectures can efficiently store and retrieve domain-specific knowledge in distributed, memory-constrained topologies.
